title: Mount hearts above hunger and experience bar while riding
description: The mount's hearts sit one row above the hunger bar while your experience bar and level stay visible.

title: Jump bar while charging a jump
description: The experience bar turns into the jump bar automatically while you hold jump.

title: Mount hearts on the left above armor
description: You can also place the mount's hearts on the left side above your armor row.

title: Horse stats in the inventory screen
description: Your mount's health, speed in blocks per second and jump height in blocks are shown in the horse inventory.

title: Settings screen
description: Configure the mount hearts position, jump bar behavior and mount stats display in-game.
